purpose: Reusable script engine registry (§27). Production status is honest: only Latin (source) and Devanagari (Hindi) have real rendering + transliteration + typing support in the product today. All other scripts are listed with PLANNED status — no course content, no transliteration, no typing trainer exists for them yet.

scripts.name: Latin
scripts.note: Source-language script; every UI and English page renders natively.

scripts.name: Devanagari
scripts.transliteration: Latin → Devanagari via js/translit.js rule engine; Google Input Tools API used only when a secure server relay exists (it does not today), otherwise the keyless rule engine is the fallback
scripts.typing: Roman → Devanagari typing trainer + on-screen chart
scripts.note: Hindi (hi) is the only PRODUCTION target language; its script is fully supported end-to-end.

scripts.name: Arabic
scripts.note: No PRODUCTION language uses it yet; no authored content or transliteration.
